in.rationale: The draft measurement specifies this open implementation as its subject.
in.scope: The measurement would run the pinned implementation with a substituted local model, llama3.2:3b, that is available locally but not yet configured or run and whose role assignment is not set; the pinned task source sets JUDGE to ollama/qwen2.5:7b and DEBATER to ollama/llama3.1:8b, and the manifest warns that the local Llama model differs from the published Unkad runs. No theorem transfer or efficacy estimate exists. The manifest also leaves the judge access condition unset, while the implementation offers FULL, OBSCURED and NONE access; it requires a new controller that must abort on access-validation failure when applicable, whereas the published controller does not fail closed on access validation; and it uses 24 balanced candidate BoolQ items that are not yet label-audited, instead of the task source's own boolq_samples draw (n=60, max_words=180 by default).
